cases.name: Brenda L. Hatheway
cases.about: She was the mother of missing 23-year-old Sabrina Lee Hatheway, who was last seen 12/2014 & who she believed was dead & probably killed by her boyfriend.
cases.narrative: He allegedly stomped on her head.
